statement: ∀ d n : Nat, (∀ j, j < n / d + 1 → d * j ≠ n) → ¬ d * (n / d + 1) ≤ n → ¬ d ∣ n
tactic: intro d n hsmall hover ⟨k, hk⟩ cases Nat.lt_or_ge k (n / d + 1) with | inl hlt => exact hsmall k hlt hk.symm | inr hge => have h1 : d * (n / d + 1) ≤ d * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d hge exact hover (hk ▸ h1)
